newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent Group Three unleaded firms.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent Group Three unleaded firms.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline basis firmed in Group Three as an outage at a key regional refinery pushed differentials higher, traders said on Wednesday.
"The Group gas is the hot number right now," one trader active in the Midwest markets said.
An outage and planned maintenance at Farmland's 90,000 barrel per day Coffeyville, Kan., refinery was sparking the run-up in unleaded and diesel basis in the Group, traders said.
Unleaded gasoline was bid -.75 cent a gallon over NYMEX March unleaded in Group Three and 2.50 cents under the print in Chicago for prompt barrels.
Low sulphur diesel was bid 1.50 cents a gallon over NYMEX March heating oil in Group Three and 2.75 cents over the print in Chicago for prompt barrels in afternoon discussion, traders said.
High sulphur diesel was bid 0.75 cents a gallon under the print in Group Three and 0.75 cent over the print in Chicago. moving sharply higher in both markets.
Jet/kero continued to soar, reaching bids 4.25 cents over the print in Group Three and 4.0 cents over in Chicago, traders said.
